findings.title: Durable EventStore path exists; UI still lacks MEM-1 audit export
findings.detail: Paper org now writes lineage to data/audit/events.jsonl by default. Remaining gap: Watchfloor UI does not surface or export that graph.
findings.implementation_task: Add MEM-1 audit export endpoint/bridge so the UI can read data/audit/events.jsonl lineage for each proposal_id.

findings.title: Permissions exist in registry flags but are not enforced in the UI
findings.detail: UI create-agent flow can invent custom agents without going through GOV-CHAIR proposal queue or ceiling checks in code.
findings.implementation_task: Gate UI agent creation behind council proposal objects validated against agent_ceiling and COMP-1 mandate checks.

findings.title: No real market/news/filings adapters behind MKT-1/ALT-1
findings.detail: Paper path uses synthetic verified bars. Intel desks (GEO/MACRO/…) have mandates but no normalized MarketEvent feed contract wired in.
findings.implementation_task: Implement MarketEvent adapters (bars, calendar, filings, news) with source_verified + tagging, delivering slices to intel/pred consumers.

findings.title: Dual-source confirmation for macro prints not encoded
findings.detail: MACRO-1 / POLICY-1 should require two-source confirm before FORE-1 publishes high-confidence calls.
findings.implementation_task: Add dual_source_required flag for macro event types in DQ-1.

findings.title: ML-ARCH autonomy budget not instrumented
findings.detail: Pattern Recognition ML claims self-building below compute ceiling, but there is no compute meter, model registry, or failover SLA.
findings.implementation_task: Add hard_rules.compute_ceiling and a model-routing health endpoint; ML-ARCH proposals above ceiling require GOV-CHAIR.

findings.title: Separate local paper inference from optional cloud workloads
findings.detail: Phase-1 paper org should stay local/deterministic; cloud only for experimental ML cells.
findings.implementation_task: Document and enforce Environment.EXPERIMENTAL for ML self-builds.

findings.title: Fixed-dollar cohort sizing wired; fund/quant sleeves still %NAV
findings.detail: PaperBroker + RISK-1 honor suggested_size_usd for fixed_1_2_usd cohorts. Continue separating paper experiment capital from stewardship sleeve capital.
findings.implementation_task: Expose paper_experiment_capital_usd vs stewardship_sleeve_capital_usd in portfolio state exports for BRK-SAFE.

findings.title: Same-symbol cluster check exists; full correlation matrix still missing
findings.detail: RISK-1 rejects when same-symbol cluster exceeds max_correlated_cluster_pct. Cross-name rolling correlation matrix remains a P2 gap.
findings.implementation_task: Add rolling cross-name correlation matrix feeding CORR-Q.

findings.title: REG-1 regime service admits proposals; richer regime engine still needed
findings.detail: RegimeService gates FIT-1 admission against contract valid/invalid regimes. Next: data-driven regime labels owned by HEAD-TRADE / REG-1.
findings.implementation_task: Replace static regime labels with tape/vol feature classifier.

findings.title: Per-symbol daily order cap live; slippage ledger still thin
findings.detail: 103 trading-division agents share a per-symbol daily cap of 20.
findings.implementation_task: Persist EXEC-1 slippage scorecards per fill for ATTR-1.

findings.title: EXEC-1 is both quality analyst and sole order placer
findings.detail: Watchfloor nick 'Fill Check' mixes measurement with authority. Keep execution authority, but split attribution of fill quality to ATTR-1.
findings.implementation_task: Clarify EXEC-1 contract: place authorized paper orders; ATTR-1 owns slippage scorecards.

findings.title: Proposer contract stubs complete; promote from stub to validated
findings.detail: All proposers have measurable setup/entry/exit stubs and FIT-1 blocks incomplete contracts. Next: empirically validate expressions.
findings.implementation_task: Run BACK-1/STAT-1 validation packs per contract; mark contract_completeness=validated_v1 when OOS gates pass.

findings.title: No walk-forward / OOS harness wired to HYPO-1 and BACK-1
findings.detail: Lab seats exist; controlled improvement sequence is documented but not automated.
findings.implementation_task: Build hypothesis registry + point-in-time backtest queue with FIT-1/COST-1 veto.

findings.title: Quant evidence_package_id gate is live; packages still synthetic in paper
findings.detail: FIT-1 requires evidence_package_id on RT/quant proposals before RISK-1.
findings.implementation_task: Replace paper stub packages with FIT-1/COST-1 signed evidence objects.

findings.title: ResearchSignal not produced by intel/pred desks in Watchfloor runtime
findings.detail: CORP-1/BULL-1/BEAR-1/FORE-1 exist, but paper path synthesizes a single CORP-1 signal. Standardized research→signal handoff is incomplete.
findings.implementation_task: Route intel/pred outputs through ResearchSignal schema; strategies may only consume ResearchSignal IDs, never raw narrative blobs.

findings.title: Bull/Bear split authors need conflict metadata on case files
findings.detail: BULL-1 and BEAR-1 must never share authorship on the same case version.
findings.implementation_task: Enforce separate author_id on case file versions in org memory.

findings.title: Agent ceiling decision in force; enforce in UI create flow
findings.detail: Roster 300 ≤ ceiling 300 (GOV-CEIL-2026-07-28). UI still needs hard gate.
findings.implementation_task: Wire UI agent creation to agent_ceiling + GOV-CHAIR proposal queue.

findings.title: RECON-1 seat added; automate book vs broker mismatch halt
findings.detail: Seat exists under COMP-1; runtime recon loop still to implement.
findings.implementation_task: Implement RECON-1 daily check; mismatch → COMP-1 halt.

findings.title: Incident runbooks for SEC-HALT drills not versioned in repo
findings.detail: Kill switch exists in code; drill scorecards and restore checklist need artifacts.
findings.implementation_task: Add docs/runbooks/halt_drill.md and automate SEC-DRILL quarterly checklist.

findings.title: Activity incentives still favor many small discretionary experiments
findings.detail: 100-trader floor + novel fleet can create trading-for-learning without quality filter. Stewardship veto exists for low edge but not for unnecessary concurrent identical setups.
evidence: BRK-SAFE veto on low edge only
findings.implementation_task: Add activity budget: max new discretionary proposals/day/cohort; BRK-INV reviews duplicates of the same thesis family.

findings.title: Berkshire desk moat/MOS gate is live; scorecards still manual
findings.detail: BRK-TRD* proposals require moat_score and margin_of_safety metadata before RISK-1.
findings.implementation_task: Have BRK-MOAT/BRK-SAFE publish signed score objects instead of free-form metadata.

findings.title: Dissent: retiring mean-reversion scouts entirely is too aggressive for a lab
findings.detail: Keep SCOUT/MR-style cohorts in paper with stewardship veto and fixed $1–2 sizing; do not delete the experiment.
findings.implementation_task: Retain MR/scout cohorts; tag as experimental with elevated reject sensitivity.

findings.title: Critique resolution: single ResearchSignal schema remains mandatory
findings.detail: Intel and quant may both publish, but payload must be ResearchSignal.
findings.implementation_task: Reject non-ResearchSignal handoffs in message bus permissions.

findings.title: Critique: do not confuse lab breadth with production capital allocation
findings.detail: Paper cohorts may be wide; binding capital stays tiny and comparable.
findings.implementation_task: Separate paper experiment capital from stewardship sleeve capital in portfolio state.

decisions.title: Unified enhance sequence adopted
decisions.detail: P0: separation + ceiling governance + measurable contracts. P1: durable lineage, fixed-dollar sizing, regime gate, ResearchSignal wiring. P2: data adapters, backtest factory, ML compute budget. P3: limited live only with explicit HUMAN-1 authorization.
decisions.implementation_task: Execute tasks_by_priority in order; do not skip P0.

decisions.title: Watchfloor IDs remain canonical; council is designer/supervisor layer
decisions.detail: Institutional teams design and enhance; Watchfloor strategy agents propose; RISK-1/COMP-1/GOV-CHAIR/SEC-HALT/HUMAN-1 decide; EXEC-1 executes paper.
decisions.implementation_task: Keep IDC-* agents out of TradeProposal emission.
